issues.summary: [Teams Core 1.0.26] installed, desktop, and mobile UI evidence is missing
issues.description: Command, package, portal, and public-runtime gates passed for app version 1.0.26. The required same-release installed-client version check, desktop screenshot/AX evidence, and mobile confirmation are not yet captured. The current UI matrix has 149 rows: PASS=0, FAIL=0, BLOCKED=148, N/A=1, and all evidence slots are not-captured for the current release. Reproduce by reusing the existing Teams desktop and mobile app surfaces, then capture before/after screenshots, accessibility evidence, and runtime evidence for each exercised branch. Do not close from CLI, portal, or HTTP evidence alone.
issues.acceptance: The installed app visibly reports version 1.0.26, the desktop chat/tab and every exercised branch have fresh before/after screenshots plus AX/runtime evidence, and the mobile Teams user confirms the same release behavior. Then update this issue with evidence paths and transition it using a workflow transition discovered from Jira.

issues.summary: [Teams Core] Teams capability timeout permanently reused a stale location request
issues.description: A timed-out Teams getContext promise could keep the shared location request pending after browser fallback succeeded, causing a later user action to reuse stale runtime state. The fix explicitly abandons capability-discovery attempts on timeout while retaining the native prompt overlap lock for actual Teams location providers. Source: src/client/location.ts; regression: scripts/client-location-test.ts.
issues.acceptance: The automated timeout-to-browser-fallback-to-fresh-retry test passes, and Teams mobile confirms that a second '내 위치 사용' action performs a new location request after a host timeout without overlapping a native prompt.

issues.summary: [Teams Core] deep link to an older work item was cleared when it was outside the first page
issues.description: When the initial work-item search returned the first page without the deep-linked item, the UI cleared selection instead of fetching /api/work-items/:id. The tab now loads and prepends the linked item when it is outside the first page, with a regression helper test in scripts/client-deep-link-test.ts.
issues.acceptance: A Teams tab deep link to an item outside the initial 100-item result page opens the correct item and preserves its edit/comment controls on desktop and mobile.

issues.summary: [Teams Core] collaboration panel showed empty digest text while requests were still loading
issues.description: The collaboration panel had no loading state and rendered '아직 업데이트 digest가 없습니다' during the initial requests. It now exposes aria-busy, disables refresh while loading, and renders an explicit loading status until the latest request commits.
issues.acceptance: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a loading state during the request, a populated/empty digest only after the request settles, and an actionable error state on failure.

issues.summary: [Teams Core] GenUI error retry actions and partial weather sections were hidden
issues.description: Client GenUiCard suppressed all actions on error envelopes and treated weather sections containing only humidity or wind as empty. Error retry/refresh actions now remain visible and the section content check accepts every supported weather field. Regression coverage is in scripts/client-genui-adapter-test.ts.
issues.acceptance: Teams desktop and mobile show a usable 다시 시도/새로고침 action on an error card and render available partial weather facts without falsely showing an empty card.

issues.summary: [Teams Core] reconcile Teams CLI SSO doctor diagnostics with live bot+tab contract
issues.description: The Teams CLI doctor reports one SSO failure and warnings for the resource URI and valid-domain pattern, while the official bot+tab SSO guidance and the portal read-back show the combined resource URI and exact token.botframework.com domain. This is a diagnostic discrepancy, not a confirmed runtime defect. Compare the doctor implementation/version with the official contract and close only after a live SSO failure is reproduced or the diagnostic is verified as stale.
issues.acceptance: A fresh Teams SSO runtime check either reproduces a token exchange failure with sanitized evidence and a follow-up Bug, or documents the doctor discrepancy as non-actionable with the official contract and successful runtime evidence.
